topic: Run the relabel on the real store once 'orch rag relabel' lands
detail: Agents never run it against the user's store. After the RPC and command land and a policy is applied: run 'orch rag relabel --dry-run', review the per-transition counts, then run it for real (repeat while it reports chunks left stale). Content stored before writers were recorded (2026-10-28), client notes, sessions whose transcripts are gone and conflicts go to quarantine, to be retagged (SP-071). Supersedes the action in RC-355.
